description: This class defines a client for interacting with the AWS Savings Plans service, including methods for creating, deleting, describing, tagging, and untagging savings plans, along with their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: SavingsPlansClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with AWS Savings Plans service, extending the AwsClient base class.

methods.name: createSavingsPlanAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new Savings Plan.

methods.name: deleteQueuedSavingsPlanAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a queued Savings Plan.

methods.name: describeSavingsPlanRates
methods.description: Retrieves details about Savings Plan rates.

methods.name: describeSavingsPlanRatesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details about Savings Plan rates.

methods.name: describeSavingsPlansOfferingRates
methods.description: Provides details about available Savings Plans offering rates.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a specified resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
